result.summary:
Bounded semantic repair 1 only, delivered as a review artifact (no source applied, nothing executed, no acceptance claimed).

The two observed witnesses are that BUILDING_FACTS["workshop"] field 0 and FURNITURE_FACTS["shelf"] field 0 replaced by a String are accepted by both column_source_metadata_refusal and the clear-image predicate, because the existing owner helpers proved TYPE_ARRAY and extent but then type-checked only the gate-consumed work/max-builder indices, leaving the remaining scalars of each row uninspected. The patch closes exactly that.

metadata-row-types-repair.patch modifies ONLY godot/scripts/core/construction.gd in three small hunks, all inside the append-only validation region:
- adds one short shared static helper _fact_row_scalars_typed(fields, expected_count) immediately after _bill_shape_ok: exact extent proof first, then every scalar of the row required to be an actual TYPE_INT, no coercion, no value comparison, no new dictionary, packed buffer, domain or numeric mirror;
- _metadata_refusal_building replaces its bare B_FIELD_COUNT extent check with the shared helper call (10-field row);
- _metadata_refusal_furniture does the same with F_FIELD_COUNT (4-field row).

Everything else is untouched: the frozen SOURCE_* scalar anchors and _source_scalar_refusal ordering from the applied 184-line patch are preserved unchanged, the existing gate-consumed work/max-builder value comparisons remain, no row domain, gate order, refusal code, gameplay byte, schema or lifecycle changes, and the probe is not altered. Because the added checks run inside the same helpers the metadata gate already calls, a string in any building or furniture fact field now refuses with COLUMN_SOURCE_METADATA from the direct metadata call and, by the contract's precedence, from the clear and invalid-flag images as well — which is the frozen expectation both failing cases asserted.

Ambiguity stated rather than resolved: as before, this packet had no file-offset access, so the hunk headers carry estimated line numbers while the context lines are byte-exact; apply with `git apply --recount` or `patch --fuzz` and confirm the offsets. Whether unrelated geometry field VALUES should ever be mirrored remains explicitly out of scope and unchanged here. Re-running the diagnostic, independent review, focused/full regression, allocation discriminator, exact-head CI and the remaining witness evidence all remain outstanding.

diff --git a/godot/scripts/core/construction.gd b/godot/scripts/core/construction.gd
--- a/godot/scripts/core/construction.gd

@@ -1272,6 +1272,22 @@
 		if int(pairs[index * 2 + 1]) <= 0:
 			return false
 	return true
+
+
+static func _fact_row_scalars_typed(fields: Array, expected_count: int) -> bool:
+	"""Exact extent, then EVERY scalar of one immutable fact row is an actual TYPE_INT.
+
+	Shared by both owner fact-row helpers. Extent is proven first, then each of the row's
+	scalars -- not only the gate-consumed work/max-builder indices -- must be an actual
+	integer before any field is interpreted. Types only: no coercion, no value comparison
+	against a numeric mirror, no new dictionary, packed buffer, domain or gate.
+	"""
+	if fields.size() != expected_count:
+		return false
+	for index: int in expected_count:
+		if typeof(fields[index]) != TYPE_INT:
+			return false
+	return true
